vectors.description: fetch stream with Objects 0 and 1 of Group 5 carrying Prior Group ID Gap 2 and 3. Section 11.1: "A Group contains more than one Object with different values for Prior Group ID Gap". That makes the Track malformed (Section 2.5)
vectors.error_detail: two Objects in Group 5 carry different Prior Group ID Gap values

vectors.description: fetch stream with an object in Group 9 and then Object 0 of Group 10 carrying Prior Group ID Gap 1. Section 11.1: "An endpoint receives an Object with a Prior Group ID Gap covering an Object it previously received". The gap covers Group 9, which this stream delivered first. That makes the Track malformed (Section 2.5)
vectors.error_detail: Prior Group ID Gap 1 of Group 10 covers Group 9, received earlier

vectors.description: fetch stream with Objects 8 and 9 of Group 3, the second carrying Prior Object ID Gap 1. Section 11.3: "An endpoint receives an Object with a Prior Object ID Gap covering an Object it previously received". Section 9.16.3: "Within each group, objects are sent in Object ID order; subgroup ID is not used for ordering." The gap covers Object 8, delivered just before. That makes the Track malformed (Section 2.5)
vectors.error_detail: Prior Object ID Gap 1 of Object 9 covers Object 8

vectors.description: fetch stream with Object 0 of Group 1 carrying Prior Group ID Gap 2. Section 11.1: "An Object has a Prior Group ID Gap larger than the Group ID". That makes the Track malformed (Section 2.5), which an endpoint detects from this Object alone
vectors.error_detail: Prior Group ID Gap 2 is larger than Group ID 1

vectors.description: fetch stream with Object 1 of Group 3 carrying Prior Object ID Gap 2. Section 11.3: "An Object has a Prior Object ID Gap larger than the Object ID". That makes the Track malformed (Section 2.5), which an endpoint detects from this Object alone
vectors.error_detail: Prior Object ID Gap 2 is larger than Object ID 1

vectors.description: fetch stream with Object 0 of Group 5 carrying Prior Group ID Gap 1 twice. Section 11.1: "An Object contains more than one instance of Prior Group ID Gap". That makes the Track malformed (Section 2.5), which an endpoint detects from this Object alone
vectors.error_detail: an Object contains more than one Prior Group ID Gap

vectors.description: fetch stream in Descending Group Order with Object 0 of Group 10 carrying Prior Group ID Gap 2, then Object 0 of Group 9. Section 11.1: "An endpoint receives an Object with a Group ID within a previously communicated gap". Group 9 is within the gap Group 10 communicated. That makes the Track malformed (Section 2.5)
vectors.error_detail: Group 9 is within the Prior Group ID Gap 2 that Group 10 communicated
